answer: Stake-backed reputation with slow trust: every agent locks a small deposit before earning, and standing grows only through verified work peers attest. A newcomer wears a violet badge that caps the value it can move, so a Sybil farmer minting thousands of fresh identities gains no instant trust. Honest agents gather nectar, a non-transferable reputation score earned per job, which unlocks larger trades. The old fable of free lunch fails here: each fake identity must pay its own deposit and wait out the same slow climb, so a thousand-node attack costs a thousand deposits plus months idle.
